descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S05 「现成的 spec：删除账号是真删，覆盖所有工作表，并保留审计记录」 Existing specs: deleting an account is a real deletion across every working table and keeps the audit trail

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1 Deletion is a hard delete, not a hidden flag: every record that clears (at its window, or when a patient or account is deleted) is gone from the database, queryable as gone, and is not merely hidden …（UAT OAT-04；UAT OAT-04 step 2；TFA-94699 AC 1；TFA-92568 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress; TFA-92568 in progress
  • T5 Deleting a patient hard-deletes all of their data immediately (backups per OAT-04), and the audit log is kept.（TFA-94699 AC 4；UAT TC-24 Expected 5；TFA-92568 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress; TFA-92568 in progress

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Fresh physician with Hospital, Nursing Home and Clinic patients, a census import, a Quick Dictation compartment, unassigned dictation, a template, settings and handoffs; a colleague account; a second physician with a 30-patient census

When account:deleteMine runs

Then 0 raw rows per working table for the account (account:_rowCountsForTests, so a flagged row would still count); every earlier audit row kept; an op=delete audit row (via account_deleted) for the manually added Hospital patient and for the resident; the colleague keeps the handoff the deleted account sent; …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions in e2e/api/account-deletion.spec.ts, exactly as asserted: accountRowCounts 0 per table, earlier audit rows kept, delete rows for rounding.id and snf.id (expect.arrayContaining), the census rows 0 and 30 removals. …

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S05 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-04.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。

UAT item: OAT-04 Data Retention · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-04/S05

Existing specs: deleting an account is a real deletion across every working table and keeps the audit trail

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress); TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

Result: passed in matrix/OAT-04.results.json (lane A: the existing Playwright specs below, run on the local stack; agent-matrix.sh).

Existing specs:

  • api/account-deletion.spec.ts [api] — deleting an account removes its data and identity, keeps the trail, and leaves colleagues untouched — expected
  • api/account-deletion.spec.ts [api] — a full census is deleted across several batches — expected

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane A runs Tim's Playwright spec e2e/api/account-deletion.spec.ts, which makes its own fresh fixture accounts (freshAccount, a colleague, a 30-patient census) and reads account:_rowCountsForTests and the audit rows with the admin key; dev has neither, and Delete account is always refused there (…. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
